import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Content

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response by safely embedding user-provided content. Args: user_input (str): Content supplied by the user to be inserted into the page. Returns: str: The final HTML string with the escaped user content. """ # Escape all characters that have special meaning in HTML to prevent XSS safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Replace the placeholder with the escaped content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
